working_on.task: Fixed and verified all 8 Medium (P2) performance bottlenecks across DB, Backend, and Frontend
working_on.notes: Resolved PERF-008 through PERF-015: dropped duplicate index, fixed DOB RPC 'all' filter, consolidated 7 permissive RLS policies, memoized 3 Context Providers, optimized CountUp to 0 re-renders, reused cached settings in getDrugPresets, switched to scalar RPC for low stock count, added server-side stock filter with generated column and partial indexes. All verified by 14 unit & integration tests and Supabase performance linter.

recent_changes.description: Resolved PERF-008, PERF-009, PERF-010, PERF-013 via migration 20261103000006_fix_p2_medium_issues.sql applied to Supabase database.
Fixed PERF-014 by mutating DOM textContent via useRef in CountUp.tsx with module-level Intl.NumberFormat singleton, eliminating 60-120 re-renders/sec.
Fixed PERF-015 by memoizing context values with useMemo and callbacks with useCallback in SettingsContext, ThemeContext, and Toast.
Fixed PERF-011 by reusing getCachedSettings() in getDrugPresets() to eliminate redundant settings table round-trips.
Fixed PERF-012 by creating getLowStockCount() calling scalar RPC get_low_stock_count instead of fetching full entity array for badge count.
Fixed PERF-013 by adding server-side stock filter in getAllMedicines, using Postgres is_low_stock generated column, updating MedicineList URL searchParams pagination.
Created comprehensive test suite tests/p2-medium-performance.test.ts verifying all P2 fixes against live database.

errors_encountered.error: Supabase linter reported 7 multiple_permissive_policies and duplicate index on prescriptions_header
errors_encountered.solution: Dropped duplicate index and restructured management policies into INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE while keeping single SELECT policies.

decisions_made.decision: Use Postgres generated column is_low_stock STORED for medicines stock filtering
decisions_made.reason: Allows native PostgREST filtering and exact count pagination without requiring custom views or manual client-side memory slicing.

decisions_made.decision: Update CountUp via direct DOM nodeRef.current.textContent
decisions_made.reason: Bypasses React reconciliation loop entirely during 60-120fps animation frames while preserving exact initial SSR rendering.
